content_preview.title: GitHub CLI's New gh event listen Command Lets Developers Wait for Pull Request Events Instead of Polling
content_preview.summary: GitHub CLI v2.105.0 adds gh event listen, a preview command built on GitHub Event Streams that waits for pull request changes instead of polling in a loop.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

GitHub CLI now has a command for waiting on a pull request to change instead of checking it repeatedly in a loop. According to [GitHub's changelog](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-18-wait-for-pull-request-events-with-github-cli), "GitHub CLI now supports GitHub Event Streams," and with `gh` v2.105.0, "you and your agents can wait for a pull request to change with a single command instead of polling it in a loop."
